task: Cold prelaunch review of the queued raw-variance hidden-64 LSTM continuation from 10 to at most 20 total epochs

findings.evidence: The focused resume test exercises Adam-state restoration, epoch numbering, compilation, and W&B resume arguments, but does not exercise extend_raw64.py's completion gate. At review time the original run was still in epoch 10, so a live continuation result was unavailable.
findings.fix: After epoch 10 completes, inspect its checkpoint and ten epoch rows and verify the continuation log reports the best-epoch restart and the expected W&B ID before treating the extension as running successfully.
